needed.evidence: Informal path under 1m wide, with obstructions
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable sidewalk at least 1m wide along the left side to provide safe pedestrian access.

needed.evidence: Obstructions on the narrow sidewalk under 1m wide
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the right-side sidewalk to ensure it is fully usable and accessible for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections on the underdeveloped footway
needed.suggestion: Repair the uneven sections on the footway to prevent tripping hazards and ensure pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: Broken or uneven pavement on the narrow footway
needed.suggestion: Smooth and repair the uneven pavement on the right-side footway to improve safety for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No adequate crossing facility despite pedestrian demand
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with a refuge island for safe crossing of the busy road.

needed.evidence: Marked crossing is poorly visible and may not stop drivers
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the crossing with raised kerbs, better markings, and high-visibility signs to ensure drivers stop for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Dropped kerbs are missing at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Add kerb ramps at the crossing points to provide safe and accessible paths for pedestrians, including those with mobility challenges.
